test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, Hare sitting around circular table facing the center.

C is third to the right of A.

E is second to the left of C.

B is opposite A.

D is to the immediate right of B.

G is an immediate neigbor of F, who is not an immediate neighbor of A

Who is sitting to the immediate left of D?
solution:
**Given: **Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, Hare sitting around circular table facing the center.

1) C is third to the right of A.

2) E is second to the left of C.

3) B is opposite A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb646b25b7b882b831ee60c55a9dc584ccd9c38a02a22cd4b3f8bcb297fb85dd.png] 

4) D is to the immediate right of B.

5) G is an immediate neighbor of F, who is not an immediate neighbor of A.

After positioning D, F and G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/476f18804427aa32b1af30e578a758b2758f4a7f0e1a3fcc09915f9e314433fc.png] 

Thus, B is sitting to the immediate left of D.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
